Grain: a play's base points. They come from its cards and its hand type.
Zeal: what a play's Grain is multiplied by. A play scores Grain × Zeal.
Commons: the pool both peasants' scores go into. When the round ends it is split by declared need.

The first to call holds the landlord seat. Anyone who hasn't passed may then grab it once, and a caller who was grabbed from may grab it back. Calling an open seat is free. Grabbing a held seat adds Resentment, which makes the villagers play harder against you. Who bids first moves round the table. The landlord keeps the seat until they lose a round.
